sources.finding: Production readiness loads QUEUE_PATH (default content/queue.json), validates its item IDs and cadence metadata, but does not load or reconcile content/long-form-queue.json.

findings: The first two long-form topics in the operational queue do not match the detailed long-form planning queue.
The canonical owner-approved Long-form 001 Nile crocodile script is not the first item in content/queue.json.
The second item in content/long-form-queue.json explicitly has no cycle assignment.
The owner has not confirmed which queue controls the next production slot or approved the second long-form topic.
The readiness script does not currently detect this cross-queue identity mismatch, so a structurally valid operational queue could still point at the wrong content identity.

requiredOwnerDecisions: Confirm whether content/long-form-queue.json is authoritative for long-form content identity while content/queue.json remains the operational dispatch queue.
Confirm that long-form-001-two-eyes-above-water is the first long-form publication-cycle item.
Select or approve the second long-form topic and stable item ID.
requiredEngineeringWork: Add a fail-closed cross-queue identity reconciliation gate to production readiness and dispatch entry points.
Add regression tests for mismatched IDs, missing queue, duplicate IDs and explicit owner-approved mapping.
Rerun production readiness and exact-revision tests after implementation.
